items.title: AMD, Broadcom, CoreWeave stocks rise on Nvidia earnings beat
items.summary: Semiconductor and AI infrastructure stocks moved higher in after-hours trading on Tuesday after AI chip heavyweight Nvidia posted better-than-expected quarterly results.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Techs Jump As Nvidia Beats, Says This On Jensen Huang; Target, Anthropic IPO Ahead
items.summary: Nvidia earnings beat after the stock market broke below recent lows. Target earnings are on tap, with the Anthropic IPO set to price Wednesday night.

items.title: Nvidia Is Only 17% of SMH. After Its Beat, the Chip ETF Jumped Almost as Much as Nvidia Did
items.summary: Nvidia is 17% of the biggest chip ETF, but SMH rose almost as much as Nvidia after its beat. Where the move came from, what happened after past reports, and what it means for a $10,000 stake.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 17: Nvidia Slides Ahead of Earnings but Soars in After Hours Trading
